_comment: A local REALITY server, built from vendor/Xray-core, for testing the client end to end.
It exists because the alternative is testing against production: the live node proved the
REALITY layer once, but every later change — VLESS framing, Vision, the data path — needs a
server that can be broken, restarted and instrumented without anyone noticing. The keys here
are generated for this file and are not secret; the uuid is a test identity and nothing else.
dest points at a real site because REALITY needs a real one: a client that fails to
authenticate must receive genuine content, and that is also how a wrong client is diagnosed —
it gets avito, not an error.
minClientVer IS LOAD-BEARING ON AN XRAY OLDER THAN v26.9.9 AND MUST NOT BE DROPPED THERE. Left
out, Xray up to v26.7.28 did not leave it unset: it filled in 26.3.27 and logged a warning
nobody reads (the branch v26.9.9 keeps commented out, infra/conf/transport_security.go:117-119;
a v26.9.9 server leaves it unset). An older server then refuses every client reporting an
older version — the check is the first of four at vendor/REALITY/tls.go:272-276 — and the
refusal is REALITY's, which means
the client is served the real cover site and reports 'verification failed'. It looks exactly
like a broken client.
Measured on 2026-09-07: this client passes such a server anyway, because it reports Xray's own
version (ClientVer 26.7.28 when measured, 26.9.9 since 2026-09-26) as part of being
indistinguishable, while sing-box reports 1.8.1
and is turned away. An ad-hoc stand written without this line therefore appears to prove that
sing-box cannot reach a REALITY server at all, and it cost a day of believing exactly that. A
server that sets it accepts both.
